name: Crash Zoom
description: A static wide that punches in hard to one detail and stops dead. Kling pro keeps the landing crisp.
prompt: Static wide shot, then a sudden fast punch-in to {{subject}} and its {{detail}}, snaps to a hard stop, slight motion blur only during the zoom, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: slow zoom, drifting after the stop, cuts, morphing, text

slots.name: detail
slots.label: Detail to land on
slots.help: The part the zoom stops on, e.g. 'the ingredients list'.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
